panels.title: Token throughput by kind — 1m rate
panels.description: Derived from vLLM's own counters, so a burst between scrapes is not lost. prompt_tokens_by_source splits the prompt side into cache hits and tokens that actually had to be computed; the parts sum to vllm:prompt_tokens_total.

panels.title: Tokens in the selected range — input / cached-input / output
panels.description: increase() over the dashboard range. Reset-safe (a restart is a reset Prometheus already understands) and attributed per model_name, so switching the pair between DeepSeek and GLM never adds one model's history to the other's.

panels.title: KV cache usage and queue
panels.description: kv usage is a 0-1 fraction of the pool vLLM sized at boot (635,609 tokens on this pair with GLM at 262K = 2.42 full-context streams). waiting_by_reason separates a queue caused by slot capacity from one caused by deferred scheduling.

panels.title: Speculative decoding (MTP) — acceptance
panels.description: The draft head's hit rate. accepted/drafted is the overall ratio; the per-position series is the chance the k-th drafted token survives, which is what says whether MTP_NUM_TOKENS should go up or down. Empty when MTP_NUM_TOKENS=0.

targets.expr: sum by (model_name, position) (increase(vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_per_pos_total{model_name=~"$model"}[5m])) / on(model_name) group_left sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:spec_decode_num_drafts_total{model_name=~"$model"}[5m]))

panels.title: Request latency quantiles
panels.description: Computed from vLLM's histograms at query time, so any quantile is available here — unlike the single p95 the sparkDash probe precomputes.

panels.title: Prefix cache hit ratio and finish reasons
panels.description: Both counters are in tokens, so the ratio is the share of prompt tokens served from the prefix cache. finished_reason=length or repetition rising is usually a client problem, not a server one.

panels.title: Network throughput (rate of byte counters — burst-safe)
